resources.string: I-EspeakZ yinjini yokuguqula umbhalo ube inkulumo ye-Android. Iyisitsha esikhishwe kuhlelo lokusebenza lwe-eSpeak NG ye-Android futhi ikhuluma ngenjini yenkulumo ye-eSpeak NG, esekela izilimi nezinhlobo zokubizwa ezingaphezu kuka-100. I-EspeakZ ayisona isilinganiso esisemthethweni se-eSpeak NG futhi ayigunyazwanga yiphrojekthi ye-eSpeak NG. Ifakwa eduze kohlelo lokusebenza olusemthethweni.

string-array.name: about_privacy
string-array.item: I-EspeakZ ayiqoqi mininingwane futhi ayixhumi ku-inthanethi ngenxa yanoma yini. Ayicelli nemvume ye-inthanethi.
Lokho okufundwa yi-EspeakZ, amasethingi ayo nedatha yezwi kuhlala kudivayisi yakho.

Ngezilimi ezimbili, i-EspeakZ inikeza umbhalo wolimi lwesibili kunjini oyikhethele izwi layo. Imigomo yobumfihlo yayo leyo njini iyasebenza kuwo, futhi izwi elimakwe ngokuthi «idinga i-inthanethi» lithumela lowo mbhalo kumhlinzeki walo.

string-array.name: about_goals
string-array.item: Inhloso: inkulumo kusukela esicelweni sokuqala emva kokufaka, ngaphandle kokuvala nokuvula injini futhi ngaphandle kwesinyathelo esengeziwe sokufaka. Kwenziwe.
Inhloso: i-Klatt uhlobo 6 njengohlobo lwezwi oluzenzakalelayo. Kwenziwe.
Inhloso: ikhodi ye-Android yohlelo lokusebenza ibhalwe kabusha nge-Kotlin. Kwenziwe.

string-array.name: about_changes
string-array.item: I-EspeakZ iqale ku-eSpeak NG 1.53.0 ka-22 Septemba 2026. Izinguquko ezingezansi zenziwe ngo-Okthoba 2026.

Inkulumo kusukela esicelweni sokuqala: idatha yezwi iyafakwa lapho nje uhlelo lokusebenza luqala, futhi injini iyayilinda esikhundleni sokuthula, ngakho amazwi okuqala esifundi sesikrini ayakhulunywa.
Izilimi zezwi: ukuqala kokuqala kufaka izilimi zedivayisi yakho nesiNgisi. Engeza noma susa izilimi kuMasethingi, Izilimi zezwi.
I-Klatt uhlobo 6 yiyo uhlobo lwezwi oluzenzakalelayo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lubhalwe nge-Kotlin, futhi injini ayiqali kabusha ngenkathi ikhuluma.
Ukuqala okusheshayo: ngemva kokuqala kokuqala, injini ikulungele emahlandla ambalwa kwamakhulu esekhondi, ngisho nasewashini.
Izwi eligcwele kakhudlwana: ukuthuthukiswa kwe-bass kuphakamisa amafrikhwensi aphansi ezwi ngalinye nge-8 dB, ngaphandle kokuhlanekezela.

Kulungisiwe: izinhlobo zezwi i-Announcer ne-Marcelo zazishiya injini ithule, izinhlobo ezimbili zazibhalwe kabili, futhi manje ukungenisa isichazamazwi se-eSpeak kusebenzisa isikhethi samafayela se-Android futhi kugcina lapho injini ifunda khona.

Uhlelo lokusebenza luqanjwe i-EspeakZ, ngesihlonzi sohlelo lokusebenza i-com.espeakz.app, ngakho lufakwa eduze kohlelo lokusebenza olusemthethweni lwe-eSpeak NG. Lunesithonjana sesiqalisi esivula amasethingialo.

Izilimi ezimbili: izilimi ezimbili zifundwa ngesikhathi esisodwa, olunye lubhalwe ngezinhlamvu zesiLatini nolunye ngeyinye ialfabhethi, njengesiNgisi nesiArabhu, ngalunye ngezwi laso ukusuka ku-EspeakZ noma kunoma iyiphi injini efakiwe. Ulimi ngalunye luzigcinela izwi laso, isivinini sokukhuluma, ukuphakama kwezwi nevolumu, ngakho ezinengi zingasethwa futhi ezimbili zisetshenziswe. Wena ukhetha ukuthi yiliphi izwi elifunda izinombolo, ukubhala ngezimpawu nama-emoji, futhi amazwi amabili alandelana ngaphandle kwezikhala.
Izimpendulo ezisheshayo: nge-TalkBack, umsindo wokuqala wesicelo ngasinye uza emahlandla ambalwa kwamakhulu esekhondi, ngisho nasewashini, futhi ukumisa kuyasebenza ngokushesha.
Ulimi lwe-EspeakZ: i-EspeakZ ikhuluma ngolimi lwedivayisi yakho, kanti isiNgisi esijwayelekile yisiNgisi saseMelika, futhi ingasebenzisa ulimi olulodwa kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza.
Izinombolo ezinde kuno-6 wezinombolo zingafundwa inombolo eyodwa, ezimbili noma ezintathu ngesikhathi.
Gcina i-EspeakZ isebenza icela i-Android ukuthi ishiye i-EspeakZ ngaphandle kokonga ibhethri. I-EspeakZ ikhuluma nasesikrinini sokukhiya.
Amasethingi anale sikrini esithi Mayelana ne-EspeakZ esinomlobi, izinguquko, abathathwe njengabanikelayo nelayisense.
Isakhiwo sephrojekthi nokwakha kwashintshwa ukuze uhlelo lokusebenza lwakheke ne-Windows.

I-eSpeak, eyadalwa nguJonathan Duddington, i-eSpeak NG esekelwe kuyo.
